title: Market Intelligence (ACB) data contract
description: Field-name contract for the ACB (Asia Commercial Bank) 'Market Intelligence' demo — a Vietnam macro + capital-market monitor for Priority-Banking advisors that flows Data -> Dashboard -> Insight -> Advisor Brief -> Report. Six tables: market_metrics_monthly (tidy long macro + monthly-aggregated market metrics), market_daily (granular VN-Index/turnover/foreign-flow/PE/PB), theme_summary (investment-theme heatmap scores), advisor_brief (curated opportunity/risk/catalyst briefs), metric_dictionary (definitions/units/sources), market_events (dated annotations). All rows are synthetic (MockData=1) but calibrated to real published 2024-2025 VN figures; every metric carries Source, SourceUrl, DataDate. The generator (services/factory/app/generators/acb.py) emits matching columns; workbook templates reference only fields listed here.

market_metrics_monthly.description: Tidy long — one row per (month, metric). 19 metrics x 30 months (2024-01..2026-06). ValueType in {rate_pct, level, index, ratio}. FavorableDirection in {up, down, neutral}.

market_daily.description: Granular daily capital-market series (trading days 2024-01-02..2026-07-10). VnIndex level, day/MTD/YTD return, turnover, foreign net/buy/sell flow, market P/E and P/B.

theme_summary.description: 6 investment themes scored on a market-favorability axis (-100..+100): Momentum, Valuation, Earnings, Flow sub-scores + Overall (their mean). Signal in {Favorable, Neutral, Unfavorable}. Powers the Advisor Cockpit heatmap.

advisor_brief.description: Curated advisor briefs. Category in {Opportunity, Risk, Catalyst}. Conviction 1-5 (with ConvictionLabel). Each links to a theme (ThemeKey), targets an ACB customer segment, and carries a thesis + ready-to-say talking point (VI + EN).

metric_dictionary.description: One row per metric key: bilingual definition, unit, category, cadence, favorable direction, and authoritative public source. Powers the agent's 'explain metric' capability.

market_events.description: Dated market/macro/policy/corporate events for annotating the index chart and grounding AI narrative. EventType in {Macro, Market, Policy, Rates, Corporate}. Impact in {Positive, Negative, Neutral} with a signed ImpactScore; RelatedMetric points at a MetricKey.
